verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile lets users start and track Copilot cloud agent tasks, and assign issues to Copilot to get a ready-to-review pull request. Users can refine that work through comments and merge it. Copilot can also be asked in natural language to guide them through repositories and open a pull request. This covers conversational browsing plus agent-driven edits delivered as PRs, but the agent runs in the cloud rather than as direct, conversation-driven git operations. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of conversational file editing, commit, pull and push operations; agent-driven code search; independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent features.
